scanNote:
WORKBOOK 5-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (23-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Planning Ahead' va to'q sariq '5'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Grammar':
6) 'Read about each situation, then make predictions using going to and a phrase from the list.' Qiya: 'become a vegetarian, replace them, become a firefighter, go whitewater rafting, make a reservation, pick it up'. 1 A customer has complained that the knives and forks are dirty. The waiter ...... 2 Bob's dry cleaning is ready. He ...... 3 Young James is an animal lover who hates eating meat. He ...... 4 Sarah wants to go on an adventure holiday. She ...... 5 George wants to save lives and he's not afraid of danger. He ......
7) 'The Smiths are organising a party for their son, Jason. Look at the pictures and use the prompts to make sentences about what they are going to do, as in the example.' 5 RASM: 1 tug'ilgan kun taklifnomasi - send/invitations; 2 chelak va shvabra - clean/house; 3 sharlar - decorate/house with balloons; 4 tort - make/birthday cake; 5 sovg'a qutisi - buy/present for Jason. 1 ...They're going to send invitations.... 2-5 bo'sh.

O'NG USTUN:
8) 'Barbara is going on holiday to Jamaica next week, so she is going shopping this afternoon. First study her shopping list and cross out the things that she doesn't need for her holiday, then make sentences about what she is/isn't going to buy as in the examples.' LIST (rasmli): suncream, swimsuit, flippers, jacket, gloves, boots, umbrella, flip-flops, shorts, sunglasses. Qiya namuna: 'She is going to buy some suncream. She isn't going to buy an umbrella.'
9) 'Match the problems to the offers, as in the example.' PROBLEMS: 1 My car has broken down. 2 I'm very cold. 3 I've lost my pencil. 4 My back really hurts. 5 I'm hungry! 6 My jumper is dirty. OFFERS: a I'll give you one. b I'll wash it for you. c I'll make some sandwiches. d I'll drive you to the supermarket. e I'll close the window. f I'll phone the doctor. Strelka: 1 → d.
10) 'Complete the short dialogues with will, won't or am going to.' 1 A: Why are you wearing a suit and tie? B: I ...... meet my new boss this afternoon. 2 A: I can't pick up this box. B: I ...... help you with it. 3 A: Don't forget to buy some tomatoes today. B: Don't worry, I ...... . 4 A: What are your plans for Sunday? B: I ...... visit my grandparents. 5 A: The music is too loud! B: Okay, I ...... turn the volume down. 6 A: This coffee is too strong. B: I ...... put some more milk in it. 7 A: Don't come home late tonight. B: Don't worry, Mum. I ...... . 8 A: It's quite cold today. B: Yes, it is. I think it ...... snow.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '23'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read about each situation, then make predictions using going to and a phrase from the list: become a vegetarian, replace them, become a firefighter, go whitewater rafting, make a reservation, pick it up.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir vaziyat haqida o'qing, so'ng 'going to' va ro'yxatdagi ibora bilan bashorat qiling: become a vegetarian, replace them, become a firefighter, go whitewater rafting, make a reservation, pick it up.
exercises.explanationUz:
'BE GOING TO' - DALILGA ASOSLANGAN
  BAShORAT (coursebook 36-bet
  qoidasi).

  Vaziyat → nima bo'lishi aniq:
  1 iflos pichoq-vilka → ofitsiant
    ularni ALMAShTIRADI (replace
    them)
  2 kimyoviy tozalash tayyor → olib
    KETADI (pick it up)
  3 go'shtni yomon ko'radi →
    VEGETARIAN bo'ladi
  4 sarguzasht ta'tili → RAFTINGGA
    boradi
  5 hayot saqlash, xavfdan
    qo'rqmaydi → O'T O'ChIRUVChI
    bo'ladi

  ⚠ 'make a reservation' -
  ORTIQChA (6 ibora, 5 gap).


⚠ 'DRY CLEANING':

  = kimyoviy tozalash (kiyim).


⚠ 'WHITEWATER RAFTING':

  = tog' daryosida rezina qayiqda
  suzish (ekstremal sport).


⚠ 'TO COMPLAIN':

  = shikoyat qilmoq. 'has
  complained' - present perfect.


⚠ 'A FIREFIGHTER':

  = o't o'chiruvchi (= fireman).

items.sentence: A customer has complained that the knives and forks are dirty. The waiter ___ .
items.uz: Mijoz pichoq va vilkalar iflos deb shikoyat qildi. Ofitsiant ularni almashtiradi.

items.sentence: Bob's dry cleaning is ready. He ___ .
items.answer: is going to pick it up
items.uz: Bobning kimyoviy tozalashga bergan kiyimi tayyor. U uni olib ketadi.

items.sentence: Young James is an animal lover who hates eating meat. He ___ .
items.answer: is going to become a vegetarian
items.uz: Yosh Jeyms hayvonlarni sevadi va go'sht yeyishni yomon ko'radi. U vegetarian bo'ladi.

items.sentence: Sarah wants to go on an adventure holiday. She ___ .
items.answer: is going to go whitewater rafting
items.uz: Sara sarguzasht ta'tiliga bormoqchi. U raftingga boradi.

items.sentence: George wants to save lives and he's not afraid of danger. He ___ .
items.answer: is going to become a firefighter
items.uz: Jorj hayotlarni saqlamoqchi va xavfdan qo'rqmaydi. U o't o'chiruvchi bo'ladi.

exercises.instructionEn: The Smiths are organising a party for their son, Jason. Look at the pictures and use the prompts to make sentences about what they are going to do, as in the example. 1 send/invitations 2 clean/house 3 decorate/house with balloons 4 make/birthday cake 5 buy/present for Jason
exercises.instructionUz: Smitlar o'g'illari Jeyson uchun bazm uyushtirishyapti. Rasmlarga qarang va ko'rsatmalar bilan ular nima qilmoqchi ekani haqida gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 send/invitations 2 clean/house 3 decorate/house with balloons 4 make/birthday cake 5 buy/present for Jason
exercises.explanationUz:
'BE GOING TO' - REJA.

  QOLIP: They're going to + FE'L +
  ...

  ⚠ 'the Smiths' = Smitlar oilasi →
  'They'.


⚠ 'TO SEND INVITATIONS':

  = taklifnomalar yubormoq.


⚠ 'TO DECORATE':

  = bezatmoq. 'balloons' = sharlar.


⚠ 'TO ORGANISE A PARTY':

  = bazm uyushtirmoq.
modelAnswers: They're going to clean the house.
They're going to decorate the house with balloons.
They're going to make a birthday cake.
They're going to buy a present for Jason.

exercises.instructionEn: Barbara is going on holiday to Jamaica next week, so she is going shopping this afternoon. First study her shopping list and cross out the things that she doesn't need for her holiday, then make sentences about what she is/isn't going to buy as in the examples. LIST: suncream, swimsuit, flippers, jacket, gloves, boots, umbrella, flip-flops, shorts, sunglasses. Examples: She is going to buy some suncream. She isn't going to buy an umbrella.
exercises.instructionUz: Barbara kelasi hafta Yamaykaga ta'tilga ketyapti, shuning uchun bugun tushdan keyin xaridga boradi. Avval xarid ro'yxatini o'rganib, ta'tilga kerak bo'lmagan narsalarni chizib tashlang, so'ng u nimani sotib oladi/olmaydi haqida gaplar tuzing, namunalardagidek. RO'YXAT: suncream, swimsuit, flippers, jacket, gloves, boots, umbrella, flip-flops, shorts, sunglasses. Namunalar: U quyoshdan himoya kremi sotib oladi. U soyabon sotib olmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
YAMAYKA - ISSIQ OROL (Karib
  dengizi). Kerak: plyaj narsalari.
  Kerak EMAS: sovuq/yomg'ir
  narsalari.

  KERAK (is going to buy):
    suncream, swimsuit, flippers,
    flip-flops, shorts, sunglasses
  KERAK EMAS (isn't going to buy):
    jacket, gloves, boots, umbrella


⚠ ARTIKL / SOME:

  some suncream (sanalmas)
  a swimsuit, a jacket, an umbrella
  some flippers / gloves / boots /
  flip-flops / shorts / sunglasses
  (ko'plik)


⚠ 'FLIPPERS':

  = lastalar (suzish uchun).


⚠ 'FLIP-FLOPS':

  = shippak (plyaj).


⚠ 'SUNCREAM':

  = quyoshdan himoya kremi.

exercises.explanationUz:
'WILL' - ShU ONDA QAROR / TAKLIF
  (coursebook 36-bet qoidasi).

  Muammo eshitildi → darhol taklif:
  'I'LL + fe'l'.

  1 mashina buzildi → supermarketga
    olib boraman (d)
  2 sovuq → derazani yopaman (e)
  3 qalam yo'qoldi → bitta beraman
    (a)
  4 bel og'riyapti → shifokorga
    qo'ng'iroq qilaman (f)
  5 och → sendvich qilaman (c)
  6 jemper iflos → yuvib beraman
    (b)


⚠ 'I'LL' = 'I WILL':

  Og'zaki nutqda qisqartma.


⚠ 'MY BACK HURTS':

  = belim og'riyapti. 'to hurt' =
  og'rimoq.


⚠ 'HAS BROKEN DOWN':

  = buzilib qoldi (present
  perfect).

pairs.right: I'll drive you to the supermarket.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the short dialogues with will, won't or am going to.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa dialoglarni will, won't yoki am going to bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
WILL / WON'T / AM GOING TO
  (coursebook 37-bet 20-mashq).

  AM GOING TO - OLDINDAN REJA:
    1 kostyum kiygan → boss bilan
      uchrashmoqchi (reja)
    4 yakshanba rejasi → buvimnikiga
      boraman
  WILL - ShU ONDA QAROR / TAKLIF /
  BAShORAT:
    2 yordam beraman (taklif)
    5 ovozni pasaytiraman (qaror)
    6 sut qo'shaman (qaror)
    8 qor yog'adi deb o'ylayman
      (bashorat, 'I think')
  WON'T - VA'DA (inkor):
    3 unutmayman (I won't)
    7 kech kelmayman (I won't)


⚠ 'TO PICK UP':

  = ko'tarmoq.


⚠ 'TO TURN THE VOLUME DOWN':

  = ovozni pasaytirmoq.


⚠ 'STRONG COFFEE':

  = achchiq (quyuq) qahva.
